mechanism: Hydrocortisone may increase ivermectin levels by inhibiting CYP3A4-mediated metabolism and altering P-glycoprotein efflux, while corticosteroids can mask signs of ivermectin toxicity and impair immune response to parasitic infections.
action: Monitor for ivermectin toxicity (neurotoxicity, hepatotoxicity); consider dosage adjustment of ivermectin if prolonged corticosteroid therapy is required; ensure adequate treatment efficacy against parasites.
